state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** The gap `case-conversion-builds-its-result-outside-the` is closed. `Core\Str::lower`, `upper` and `fold` write through `case_mapped` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs`, so the memory limit sees every byte. `lower` keeps the final-sigma rule through `word_final_sigma`, which classifies neighbours with `std`'s own tables by probing `str::to_lowercase`. `lowerFirst` and `upperFirst` already built one exact allocation and owed nothing.

`Core\Regex\Match`'s and `Core\Str`'s perf figures are re-measured.

The only `nvs-runtime` gap left is `enum-case-that-reached-a-mixed`. It needs an ADR beyond Stage 5's one slot, so it waits for the user. It goes to `BLOCKED` only once it is the last goal-owned gap in the tree.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes. A person has to push.

A change to a `Core` implementation file stales the perf figure of every feature it implements, including sibling groups such as `Core\Regex\Match` beside `Core\Regex`. Re-measure each with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group <class>`.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest, in `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-syntax`, `nvs-types`, `editors/vscode` and `website`.
